# The World Pack's own files

This reference describes the packs installed in this build of mineworld; a build with other packs generates a different one (`docs/DECISIONS.md` `ARC-90`). It is generated from the types that read each file, so it is never edited by hand.

`world.yaml`, and the fields the World Pack format itself reads in each kind of content file. The other keys a content file may carry are the sections of [sections.md](sections.md).

<a id="world"></a>

## `world.yaml`

The World Pack's manifest, at the root of its directory.

`world.yaml`: what this world is, what it is composed of, and who is in it.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `configure` | list of [ConfigurationKey](#world-configurationkey) | no | — | — | The files in `configure/` this world has, in seeding order: each key names `configure/<key>.yaml` — an enabled System Pack's id, or `classes` or `packages`. |
| `decisions` | [DecisionsFile](#world-decisionsfile) | no | — | — | The decision list: a file of this pack, such as decisions.yaml, saying which decision model drives each seat. Absent, every seat is driven by the rule model. |
| `hosting` | [Hosting](#world-hosting) | no | — | — | How a host paces this world when it serves it: `time_scale`, the world seconds that pass per wall second unless the host says otherwise. |
| `items` | list of [EntityKey](#world-entitykey) | no | `[]` | — | The item kinds this world has. Each key names a file in `items/`: a kind of thing, not one object. |
| `mineworld` | [Compatibility](#world-compatibility) | no | — | — | The framework versions this world is authored for, such as "^0.1"; when stated, a framework outside it is refused by name. |
| `organizations` | list of [EntityKey](#world-entitykey) | no | `[]` | — | The organizations this world has. Each key names a file in `organizations/`. |
| `places` | list of [EntityKey](#world-entitykey) | no | `[]` | — | The places this world has. Each key names a file in `places/`. |
| `population` | list of [EntityKey](#world-entitykey) | no | `[]` | — | The people this world has. Each key names a file in `people/`. |
| `requires` | mapping: each key matches `^[a-z]([a-z0-9]\|-[a-z0-9])*$`, each value is [Compatibility](#world-compatibility) | no | — | — | Every pack this world uses that is not bundled, with the versions it accepts, such as `modern-goods: "^0.1"`; each is found in a directory given with --packs or MINEWORLD_PACKS. |
| `seats` | list of [EntityKey](#world-entitykey) | no | `[]` | — | The seats a client may occupy, each the key of a person in `population`. |
| `systems` | list of [SystemId](#world-systemid) | no | `[]` | — | The System Packs this world enables, in installation order. |
| `world` | [WorldIdentity](#world-worldidentity) | yes | — | — | The world's own identity: its id and its name. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
places:
  - home
  - shop
population:
  - ana
  - ben
seats:
  - ben
systems:
  - presence
  - movement
  - conversation
world:
  id: corner-shop
  name: Corner Shop
```

### Types used above

<a id="world-compatibility"></a>

#### `Compatibility`

A semver range with Cargo's meaning, such as "^0.1" (0.1.x and nothing else). Quote it in YAML.

**Type:** text.

<a id="world-configurationkey"></a>

#### `ConfigurationKey`

An enabled System Pack's id (such as calendar), or classes (the world's entity classes) or packages (its licence policy). Each names configure/<key>.yaml and is listed once.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="world-decisionsfile"></a>

#### `DecisionsFile`

A file of the pack, relative to its root, written with / on every platform, such as decisions.yaml: no \, no leading /, no empty, . or .. part, no :.

**Type:** text.

<a id="world-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="world-hosting"></a>

#### `Hosting`

How a host paces the world it serves: a time scale from 1 to 24, such as 12 for a two-hour day.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `time_scale` | whole number | no | `null` | at least 0 | World seconds per wall second when the host does not say otherwise, a whole number from 1 to 24, so a day lasts 24 h divided by it. Absent, the host's own default, 1. |

<a id="world-license"></a>

#### `License`

An SPDX licence expression, such as MIT or MIT OR Apache-2.0, checked against the SPDX licence list.

**Type:** text.

<a id="world-systemid"></a>

#### `SystemId`

The id of a System Pack, such as presence or calendar. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="world-version"></a>

#### `Version`

A semver version, such as 0.1.0.

**Type:** text.

<a id="world-worldidentity"></a>

#### `WorldIdentity`

A world's identity: the name a person reads, and the id everything else uses.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | text | yes | — | — | The World Pack's id, which must be its directory's name. |
| `license` | [License](#world-license) | no | — | — | The pack's licence, an SPDX expression (`ARC-53`). Optional to the loader, checked when stated; required by `mineworld packs validate`. Never world state. |
| `name` | text | yes | — | — | What the world is called, for a person. Not world state: no system reads it, and nothing in a simulation may branch on it. |
| `version` | [Version](#world-version) | no | — | — | The pack's release version, semver (`DECISIONS.md` `ARC-53`). Optional to the loader, checked when stated; required by `mineworld packs validate`. Never world state. |

<a id="person"></a>

## `people/<key>.yaml`

One person per file; the file's name without `.yaml` is its key.

people/<key>.yaml: one Person. Besides these fields, the file may carry the sections of the System Packs the world enables (see sections.md); any other key is refused.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `location` | [AuthoredLocation](#person-authoredlocation) | no | — | — | Where this person starts: a place, and optionally where in it and which way they face. Needs the presence system. |
| `note` | text | no | — | — | A note from whoever wrote the file, for a person reading it. No system reads it. |
| `tags` | [Tags](#person-tags) | no | — | — | Labels this person carries, such as shopkeeper. |

Example:

```yaml
location:
  place: shop
tags:
  - shopkeeper
```

### Types used above

<a id="person-authoredlocation"></a>

#### `AuthoredLocation`

Where somebody starts: a place, and optionally where in it and which way they face.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `facing` | whole number | no | `null` | — | Which way they face, in millidegrees clockwise (90000 is a quarter turn; 360000 is a whole turn). |
| `place` | [EntityKey](#person-entitykey) | yes | — | — | Which place, by its authoring key. |
| `position` | [AuthoredPosition](#person-authoredposition) | no | — | — | Where in it, in millimetres from the place's own origin. |

<a id="person-authoredposition"></a>

#### `AuthoredPosition`

A position inside a place: integer millimetres on the world's own axes.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [Millimetres](#person-millimetres) | no | `0` | — | Millimetres across the floor from the place's origin. |
| `y` | [Millimetres](#person-millimetres) | no | `0` | — | Millimetres across the floor from the place's origin, at right angles to `x`. |
| `z` | [Millimetres](#person-millimetres) | no | `0` | — | Millimetres of height. Absent means the floor, which is what a world that does not model height means. |

<a id="person-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="person-millimetres"></a>

#### `Millimetres`

A length or a coordinate, in whole millimetres (1 m = 1000).

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** -2147483648 to 2147483647.

<a id="person-tag"></a>

#### `Tag`

One label, such as cafe or night-shift. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="person-tags"></a>

#### `Tags`

Labels this entity carries; a tag listed twice counts once. Systems and clients read tags, never prose.

**Type:** list of [Tag](#person-tag).

<a id="place"></a>

## `places/<key>.yaml`

One place per file; the file's name without `.yaml` is its key.

places/<key>.yaml: one Place. Besides these fields, the file may carry the sections of the System Packs the world enables (see sections.md); any other key is refused.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | text | no | — | — | A note from whoever wrote the file, for a person reading it. No system reads it. |
| `passages` | list of [AuthoredPassage](#place-authoredpassage) | no | — | — | The places this one opens onto, each through one doorway. Needs the movement system. |
| `tags` | [Tags](#place-tags) | no | — | — | Labels this place carries, such as shop. Clients choose how to draw a place from its tags. |

Example:

```yaml
passages:
  - to: home
tags:
  - shop
```

### Types used above

<a id="place-authoredpassage"></a>

#### `AuthoredPassage`

One doorway from the place whose file states it to another place.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `here` | [AuthoredPosition](#place-authoredposition) | no | — | — | Where the doorway is in this place, if the world models positions. |
| `there` | [AuthoredPosition](#place-authoredposition) | no | — | — | Where the same doorway is in `to`, if the world models positions. |
| `to` | [EntityKey](#place-entitykey) | yes | — | — | The place it leads to, by its authoring key. A passage is stated once, in either place's file, and goes both ways. |

<a id="place-authoredposition"></a>

#### `AuthoredPosition`

A position inside a place: integer millimetres on the world's own axes.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [Millimetres](#place-millimetres) | no | `0` | — | Millimetres across the floor from the place's origin. |
| `y` | [Millimetres](#place-millimetres) | no | `0` | — | Millimetres across the floor from the place's origin, at right angles to `x`. |
| `z` | [Millimetres](#place-millimetres) | no | `0` | — | Millimetres of height. Absent means the floor, which is what a world that does not model height means. |

<a id="place-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="place-millimetres"></a>

#### `Millimetres`

A length or a coordinate, in whole millimetres (1 m = 1000).

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** -2147483648 to 2147483647.

<a id="place-tag"></a>

#### `Tag`

One label, such as cafe or night-shift. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="place-tags"></a>

#### `Tags`

Labels this entity carries; a tag listed twice counts once. Systems and clients read tags, never prose.

**Type:** list of [Tag](#place-tag).

items/<key>.yaml: one kind of item, such as bread — not one object. Besides these fields, the file may carry the sections of the System Packs the world enables (see sections.md); any other key is refused.
